title: Edit Location has a 'Set business hours for this shop' toggle, off by default
refs: SV-8699 (§4.2 Working Hours - business hours toggle)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App with access to location settings.
2. You open the Edit Location screen for a shop.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Edit Location screen.
2. Find the business hours setting and read its default state.
3. Turn the 'Set business hours for this shop' toggle ON.
custom_expected:
1. Edit Location shows a toggle labelled 'Set business hours for this shop'.
2. The toggle is OFF by default (no business hours set).
3. Turning it ON reveals a per-day working-hours editor for the shop.
